title: The Modern Contact Center Quality & Performance Checklist: 10 Things You Should Expect From Your AI Partner
summary: Discover 10 essentials for selecting an AI-powered contact center quality and performance platform, from automated QA and agent assist to actionable analytics.
body_markdown:
Not long ago, contact center technology decisions were relatively straightforward. Organizations selected tools for call recording, quality assurance, agent assistance, and reporting, often from separate vendors. Each platform served a defined purpose, and integrating the resulting data was simply part of running the operation.


AI has fundamentally changed what's possible. Today, organizations can evaluate conversations at scale, deliver real-time guidance to agents, identify performance trends, and turn customer interactions into actionable business intelligence.


But the rapid growth of AI-powered solutions has also made vendor selection more complicated. Almost every platform promises automation, intelligence, and improved efficiency. The challenge is determining which solutions can actually deliver meaningful improvements in quality, agent performance, and customer experience.


Whether you're evaluating your first AI-powered quality management platform or looking to bring QA, agent assistance, and interaction analytics together, here are ten capabilities and qualities worth insisting on.


## Your 10-Point Vendor Selection Checklist


### 1. Comprehensive, AI-Powered Quality Assurance


Traditional QA programs typically evaluate only a small sample of customer interactions, leaving leaders with an incomplete understanding of performance. Modern AI-powered QA should make it possible to evaluate every eligible interaction, identify compliance risks, and uncover coaching opportunities that manual sampling might miss.


But coverage alone isn't enough. **The quality of the evaluation matters just as much as the quantity.** Your vendor should understand how to translate human-designed scorecards into effective AI evaluations, including how to structure criteria, reduce ambiguity, and distinguish between objective requirements and more nuanced assessments.


At MosaicVoice, we've developed deep expertise in AI-powered quality evaluation. We don't simply automate an existing scorecard and hope for the best. We work with customers to optimize their evaluation frameworks so they can take advantage of AI scoring while maintaining the standards that matter to their business.


### 2. Flexible Scorecards That Adapt to Your Operation


Your QA platform shouldn't force your organization to conform to a rigid evaluation template. A healthcare contact center, a financial services operation, and a hospitality reservation team have fundamentally different requirements, and even individual programs within the same organization may need distinct scorecards.


Look for a platform that supports configurable criteria, scoring methodologies, and evaluation frameworks. You should be able to adjust what gets measured as your business evolves, without requiring a lengthy development project every time something changes.


MosaicVoice offers flexible QA configuration designed to accommodate different industries, clients, workflows, and quality standards.


### 3. Real-Time AI Agent Assistance


Quality assurance tells you what happened during an interaction. Real-time agent assistance can help improve what happens while the conversation is still underway.


A strong agent assist solution should deliver relevant information and guidance when agents need it, helping them navigate complicated questions, follow required processes, and provide consistent answers. The goal isn't to overwhelm agents with suggestions, but to reduce the time and effort required to find the right information.


MosaicVoice combines AI-powered agent assistance with conversation intelligence, helping organizations support agents during interactions while gaining visibility into performance across the operation.


### 4. Knowledge Base Connectivity


An AI assistant is only as useful as the information it can access. If agents must leave their workflow to search through multiple systems, much of the productivity benefit disappears.


Look for technology that can connect to your organization's existing knowledge resources and make relevant information accessible within the agent's workflow. Just as importantly, consider how easily that information can be maintained as policies, products, and procedures change.


MosaicVoice supports knowledge base connectivity as part of its agent assistance capabilities, helping teams make better use of the information they already have.


### 5. Intuitive Interfaces and Easy Configuration


Powerful technology shouldn't require a dedicated technical team to operate it. Contact center leaders need to be able to access insights, configure workflows, and make changes without constantly relying on vendor support or engineering resources.


During a demonstration, pay attention to how easily users can navigate the platform, modify settings, and find the information they need. Ask the vendor to show you how common administrative tasks work, not just the most impressive features.


MosaicVoice prioritizes intuitive interfaces and straightforward configuration so operational teams can spend less time managing technology and more time improving performance.


### 6. Analytics That Tell Leaders Where to Take Action


A dashboard filled with metrics isn't necessarily actionable intelligence. Contact center leaders need to know which teams are struggling, which quality criteria are consistently missed, where performance is improving, and which issues deserve immediate attention.


The best analytics platforms move beyond reporting what happened to helping leaders determine what to do next. That means making it easy to explore performance by agent, team, interaction type, scorecard criterion, and other meaningful dimensions.


MosaicVoice provides deep performance and quality analytics designed to surface coaching opportunities, operational trends, and specific areas for improvement. Rather than leaving managers to interpret disconnected reports, we help them identify where focused action can make the greatest difference.


### 7. Visibility Across the Customer Conversation


Individual quality scores are valuable, but they rarely tell the whole story. Organizations also need to understand what customers are asking about, why interactions escalate, which issues recur, and where the customer experience is breaking down.


Conversation intelligence should make it possible to analyze interactions at scale and identify patterns that might otherwise remain hidden in thousands of recordings and transcripts.


MosaicVoice helps organizations turn conversation data into insights that support better coaching, quality management, and broader operational decisions.


### 8. Industry Expertise That Goes Beyond the Software


Contact center operations vary significantly across industries. Healthcare organizations must navigate sensitive patient interactions and privacy requirements. Financial services teams operate within complex regulatory environments. Hospitality businesses need to balance efficiency with personalized service, while utilities often manage urgent, high-volume customer needs.


A vendor that understands these differences can help customers configure technology more effectively and avoid unnecessary trial and error.


MosaicVoice brings experience supporting organizations across healthcare, financial services, hospitality, utilities, and other customer-facing industries. That experience helps us understand the operational realities behind the technology, not just the features on a product roadmap.


### 9. A Partner Who Helps You Succeed After Implementation


Selecting the right platform is only the beginning. Real value depends on how effectively the technology is configured, adopted, and continuously improved.


Ask prospective vendors how they approach onboarding, scorecard development, training, and ongoing optimization. Will they help your team establish a strong foundation? Can they offer practical recommendations based on what they've learned from other deployments? And when something needs attention, will you have a partner who's invested in solving it?


At MosaicVoice, we take a hands-on, collaborative approach to customer relationships. We see our role as more than providing software. We want to help customers build effective programs, interpret their results, and continually improve how their contact centers operate.


### 10. A Platform That Can Grow With Your Needs


Your organization's requirements today may look very different a year from now. You might begin with automated QA, expand into real-time agent assistance, introduce new scorecards, or need more sophisticated analytics as your operation grows.


Choosing a flexible platform can help you avoid accumulating disconnected solutions that become increasingly difficult to manage.


Look for a technology partner with a clear product direction, a willingness to listen to customer feedback, and the ability to support evolving operational needs. MosaicVoice brings quality assurance, agent assistance, and conversation intelligence together in a platform designed to help organizations improve performance over time.


## Don't Just Evaluate the Features. Evaluate the Expertise.


It's tempting to compare vendors by counting capabilities on a spreadsheet. Does the platform offer automated QA? Check. Agent assist? Check. Analytics? Check.


But two platforms with similar feature lists can produce very different results.


The difference often comes down to how well the technology is implemented, how effectively the AI is configured, and whether the vendor understands what great contact center performance actually looks like.


For example, an automated QA solution that consistently misinterprets your scorecard may create more work than it saves. An agent assist tool that delivers irrelevant suggestions may distract agents rather than help them. And an analytics platform that produces attractive dashboards without actionable insights may do little to improve performance.


Technology is only valuable when it works in the context of your operation.


That's why we believe contact center leaders should expect more from their AI partners. They should expect technical capability, operational expertise, flexibility, and a genuine commitment to helping them succeed.


## The Bottom Line


The next generation of contact center quality and performance platforms should do more than automate existing QA processes. They should help organizations evaluate quality more comprehensively, support agents more effectively, and make better decisions using the intelligence already contained in customer conversations.


At MosaicVoice, we've built our platform and our approach to partnership around those expectations. From AI-powered QA and real-time agent assistance to configurable workflows, deep analytics, and hands-on expertise, our goal is to give contact center leaders the tools and insights they need to deliver exceptional performance.


**When you're choosing an AI partner, don't settle for a list of features. Expect a platform and a team that know how to turn those features into results.**
